title: Edmund and the Vector
author: B. M. Coldharbour
blurb: Theo Delacroix, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the jump window closes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
